## Loading data

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)

my_data_folder <- "~/"
dest_file <- file.path(my_data_folder, "stressEcho.csv")

url <- "https://hbiostat.org/data/repo/stressEcho.csv"

download.file(url, destfile = dest_file, mode = "wb")
stressEcho <- read_csv("~/stressEcho.csv", na = c("N/A"))
View(stressEcho)
```

## Preparing the data

The data is renamed for easiest identification of the variables. Also, binary events (0/1) are recoded to no/yes respectively following the description page which states - "Note that several of the original variables have been renamed and recoded for the S datasets. Event variables that originally were coded `0=yes 1=no` have been recoded `0=no 1=yes.` `equivecg` and `posecg` are combined into a new variable `ecg`. The original `hxofcig` variable had values `0`, `.5`, `1` assumed to represent heavy, moderate, and none. `%mphr(b)` has been renamed `pctMphr`." "

```{r}
stressEcho <- stressEcho |>
  select(-...1) |>
  rename(
    "BasalHeartRate(bpm)" = "bhr",
    "BasalBloodPressure(mmHg)" = "basebp",
    "BasalDoubleProduct" = "basedp",
    "PeakHeartRate(mmHg)" = "pkhr",
    "SystolicBloodPressure(mmHg)" = "sbp",
    "SysPeakDoubleProduct" = "dp",
    "DobutamineDose(mg)" = "dose",
    "MaxHeartRate(bpm)" = "maxhr",
    "MaxPredictedHeartRate(percent)" = "pctMphr",
    "MaxBloodPressure(mmHg)" = "mbp",
    MaxHeartRateDoseDoubleProduct = "dpmaxdo",
    "DobutamineDoseAtMax(mg)" = "dobdose",
    "CardiacEjectionFraction(percent)" = "baseEF",
    "DobutamineEjectionFraction(percent)" = "dobEF",
    WallMotionAbnormality = "restwma",
    PositiveStress = "posSE",
    RecentMyocardialInfarction ="newMI",
    RecentAngioplasty = "newPTCA",
    RecentBypassSurgery = "newCABG",
    HypertensionHistory = "hxofHT",
    DiabetesHistory = "hxofDM",
    SmokingHistory = "hxofCig",
    MyocardialInfarctionHistory = "hxofMI",
    AngioplastyHistory = "hxofPTCA",
    BypassSurgeryHistory = "hxofCABG",
    AnyEvent ="any.event",
    ECGDiagnosis = "ecg"
    ) |>
  mutate(chestpain = case_when(chestpain == 0 ~ "no",
                             chestpain == 1 ~ "yes"),
         WallMotionAbnormality = case_when(WallMotionAbnormality == 0 ~ "no",
                                           WallMotionAbnormality == 1 ~ "yes"),
         PositiveStress = case_when(PositiveStress == 0 ~ "no",
                                    PositiveStress == 1 ~ "yes"),
         RecentMyocardialInfarction = case_when(RecentMyocardialInfarction == 0 ~ "no",
                                                RecentMyocardialInfarction == 1 ~ "yes"),
         RecentAngioplasty = case_when(RecentAngioplasty == 0 ~ "no",
                                       RecentAngioplasty == 1 ~ "yes"),
         RecentBypassSurgery = case_when(RecentBypassSurgery == 0 ~ "no",
                                         RecentBypassSurgery == 1 ~ "yes"),
         death = case_when(death == 0 ~ "no",
                           death == 1 ~ "yes"),
         HypertensionHistory = case_when(HypertensionHistory == 0 ~ "no",
                                         HypertensionHistory == 1 ~ "yes"),
         DiabetesHistory = case_when(DiabetesHistory == 0 ~ "no",
                                     DiabetesHistory == 1 ~ "yes"),
         MyocardialInfarctionHistory = case_when(MyocardialInfarctionHistory == 0 ~ "no",
                                                 MyocardialInfarctionHistory == 1 ~ "yes"),
         AngioplastyHistory = case_when(AngioplastyHistory == 0 ~ "no",
                                        AngioplastyHistory == 1 ~ "yes"),
         BypassSurgeryHistory = case_when(BypassSurgeryHistory == 0 ~ "no",
                                          BypassSurgeryHistory == 1 ~ "yes"),
         AnyEvent = case_when(AnyEvent == 0 ~ "no",
                                 AnyEvent == 1 ~ "yes"),
         )
```

```{r}
view(stressEcho)
```
